bestBets.overview: CONVINCEBILITY comes into this ready to win third-up from spell. He has been racing oin much better races than this and with Raymond Vigar back aboard he can get away with this. BONS YOUR BACK battled on well enough when placed behind Anson Bay last Wednesday. Another that is at peak fitness third-up and he will be in the finish. TIME TO BACA was bit disappointing in the same race as Bons Your Back on Wednesday. She had been racing well prior and can bounce back while RIVKIN will be better froom his first run at Fannie Bay and expect improvement.

raceTips.comment: Three main hopes for me. Lucky Fortuna is the map horse who had excuses last start. Was slow out and had to work early to find the front. She now gets Kayla Crowther and can run an improved race. Bon’s Your Back has been racing well this preparation and only got warm late. Faces a tricky map but look for her late. Starzam also improved when slow out last start. Todd goes on and he should be primed for this.

JUMPING POWER TWO was dominant in this class last start. Step out to the 1100m should suit and no reason he will bot be in the mix again. DOWN THE WICKET chased home valiantly behind Littlebourkestreet last start. Drawn to get the perfect run in transit and he is a must for exotics while CAVERN comes to Darwin for the first time. Did mix form in Victoria but best would be good enough for this.

raceTips.comment: Good speed on paper but it’s hard to go past Littlebourkestreet who won dominantly last start. She showed tactical versatility to take a forward spot and then powered away late. Drawn out she will need a good ride, but she possesses a good turn of foot and with luck can win.

bestBets.overview: BALASTIER has demolished rivals in both runs since cooming to Darwin and he looks the premier sprinter in the Territory at the moment. Hard to see them beating him. DAKOTA LEE is such a brave mare. She won the Pioneer Sprint in Alice Springs back in May and since then she has won two of four in Darwin. Drawn ideally and will run her honest race up front. ARIZONA ACTIVIST was a bit disappointing here last start but she had been racing well prior and is a must for exotics while ZOURATA has plenty of speed and should get right right run behind the speed and get his chance.

raceTips.comment: After the scratching’s we are left with an open race. Zourata beat home Shirshov when leading all the way last start. Drawn out he will have to work to find the front but should give a great sight. Shirshov has class and has raced behind some smart types in VIC. Now third up, can improve here. Rewards And More can mix his form and has been below his best of late. Would want a late market push but is up to it.

FABERGE TZAR was well supported here last start but had to settle for minor placing. The mile looks his right trip and expect him to be in the finish again. RAMPAZETTO chased home the impressive Stompem here last start. Drawn bit wide but watch for him to be making good late ground. THE ACCELATOR was not disgraced in the same race as Rampazetto last start and would not leave him out of first four wagers.

THE GIRLS BOY won over the 1300m here two starts back then not disgraced in better race last start. Back in right race. ROSSANADO won with something in hand two back then just missed Anson Bay here on Wednesday. She can win this.

raceTips.comment: Open race here. I was with Rossanado last start who ran a bold race. HEBEL battled on well when placed in small field here two starts back then he was too bad to be true last start. Chance to bounce back in this field while THROW AT DA STUMPS has been racing in consistent form and is a must for exotics.
